[1/3] Plan: PhotoFilter.order (newest default, oldest, largest, smallest); catalog ORDER BY per side; /api/photos?order= validation; scope-bar sort select preserves dates/albums/favorites; tests, dogfood, ADR-018, README

impact_assessment.why: The gallery is always newest-first; finding the oldest photo or the files taking the most space means a different tool or scrolling
impact_assessment.benefits: One control over the existing page query; no schema change, no extra read, and it combines with every filter
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one new query parameter and scope key; dependency: none; concurrency: read-only; state: sort is client-only and resets on person/month/favorites changes
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate against a fixed set, keep a stable sha tiebreaker on every order, and preserve the chosen order when a date window is applied

[1/4] Plan: catalog format 6 adds a trash table; TrashBook moves one person's copy into .harbor/trash with a row, forgets the copy, restores through store.ingest, and deletes permanently; API list/move/restore/delete/empty; Trash tab and move actions; tests, dogfood, ADR-019, README

impact_assessment.why: There is no way to remove a bad or unwanted photo from Harbor without using Explorer; direct deletion would be irreversible and would desynchronise the catalog
impact_assessment.benefits: A safe, per-person remove with restore; shared photos stay for others; no permanent loss on the first action; trash is hidden from the library and backup
impact_assessment.risks: contract: catalog format 6 and new endpoints; dependency: none; concurrency: moves and catalog writes share the store lock; state: trash rows and files, with a crash window between move and forget
impact_assessment.mitigation: Insert the trash row before moving, move inside the store lock, roll back the file if forgetting fails, restore by re-ingesting the bytes through the normal hash-verified path, and test shared/last-copy cases plus migration

[1/4] Plan: catalog format 7 adds albums.cover_sha; summary falls back to the newest member when the chosen hash is gone; set cover validates membership; viewer Use as cover; tests, dogfood, ADR-020, README

impact_assessment.why: An album's sidebar cover is always its newest photo, which is often not the image that represents the trip
impact_assessment.benefits: One chosen image per album; no file copies; the fallback keeps old albums working and a removed cover degrades gracefully
impact_assessment.risks: contract: catalog format 7 and an albums update field; dependency: none; concurrency: cover writes share the database lock; state: one nullable column
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add the column in an additive migration, validate that the chosen hash is still a visible album member, reset it when that photo leaves the album, and test v5/v6 upgrades

[1/3] Plan: Catalog.hashes runs the same filter/order as the page with a 10,000 cap; GET /api/photos/hashes returns hashes and truncated; selection bar gets Select matching; UI selects across pages and says when the cap was hit; tests, dogfood, ADR-021, README

impact_assessment.why: Select all loaded only covers the pages already scrolled in; a 300-photo album or a wide date window still means scrolling before a bulk action
impact_assessment.benefits: One action selects the whole filtered set; reuses the existing filters, order and chunked bulk endpoints; no schema change
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new read-only endpoint and a larger client-side Set; dependency: none; concurrency: read-only; state: selection stays client-only and resets with scope
impact_assessment.mitigation: Cap at 10,000 hashes, return a truncated flag, keep the same narrowing validation as /api/photos, and chunk every write as before
